symptom: Homepage hero video could remain paused or fail to resume after autoplay/browser lifecycle interruptions despite static autoplay markup.
rootCause: Static autoplay, muted and playsinline attributes alone do not guarantee continued playback after iOS/Safari-like lifecycle, visibility or autoplay interruptions.
fix: Add runtime lifecycle recovery in assets/js/menu.js through initHeroVideoRecovery with muted/defaultMuted, playsInline, autoplay, loop and bounded play retries on readiness, pause, pageshow, visibilitychange and first safe user interaction.
prevention: Treat homepage hero video playback as a runtime contract, not markup-only; regression must validate required attributes, recovery wiring and browser playback progress where automation permits.
regressionContract: Homepage hero-video contract verifies .hero-product-video source and autoplay/muted/playsinline/loop plus initHeroVideoRecovery lifecycle recovery; targeted and broad browser gates stay green.
